g.text: Figure 4 · Input regime shapes size effects on activity memory
Native local organization and second-half summaries across four ring models
B–C: 12 independent seeds per condition; whiskers show 95% whole-seed intervals.
A: native activity (color); largest size, f=0.1; fixed window and declared medoid.
Direction requires both endpoint R≥0.1; the thin strip retains all-pair coverage.
Contrast is qualified at ≥10% of basal. Full profiles, matched mean controls and windows: supplement.
Native clocks/laws differ. Whole positive input scales with f. Activity heading is distinct from migration.
First half discarded without assuming stationarity. Spring sampled run-duration inference remains excluded.
